# Popol Vuh — QUESTIONS

(Decisions the conventions do not settle, with what was decided meanwhile.)

- 2026-11-23 · popol-vuh-002 (reviewer's flags, nothing blocked): (1) Brasseur reads g (= ꜫ) in poco / poc / pocotahic, which the established text prints with plain c; the establishment log does not discuss it. Kept as established; the establisher of later parts should look at this letter. (2) The published glossary entry `chauaxoc` gives the root as chaw 'sow', which conflicts with `ravaxic` (awax 'sow'); left unchanged, as it belongs to the pilot's entries. (3) Xuculu (unit 33) is left untranslated in the English as well, its meaning unknown; decided meanwhile to keep it so.
- 2026-11-23 · popol-vuh-003 (establish): images 0017 and 0018 in source/pages are blank; the text continues from the last line of 0016 directly onto 0019 (checked against Brasseur, nothing missing).
